record.question: Who among the following won Bronze medal in boxing in the Beijing Olympics?
record.explanation: IOC Olympic Solidarity report identifies Vijender Kumar of India as Beijing middleweight boxing bronze medallist. Printed Vijendra Singh refers to Vijender Singh; spelling must be noted. Historical exam context: 2010-03-24 (full date printed on cover). This is the source-era answer; time-sensitive roles, rankings and memberships may have changed. Evidence: https://library.olympics.com/digitalCollection/DigitalCollectionAttachmentDownloadHandler.ashx?documentId=848501&parentDocumentId=848500&skipCopyright=true&skipWatermark=true Independently checked solution, unofficial. No matching examiner answer key is asserted.
